points.text: Built a strong foundation in IT infrastructure and operations by supporting users, troubleshooting systems, and keeping services running.
Now focused on detection engineering, incident response, and cloud security in financial services and healthcare.
Curious-minded, open-source contributor making a byte of effort toward securing the planet.
Outside cybersecurity, I enjoy biking, running, and travel.

about.whyText:
This site is my central notebook and a reflection of my passion for continuous technical growth. Here, I break down complex threat vectors and document what I learn along the way.

Cybersecurity moves quickly, so staying sharp means building, testing, and sharing. Thanks for stopping by. You’re welcome to connect and collaborate.

entries.description: Led end-to-end detection and response for Fortune 10 healthcare organizations and global financial clients. Built detections and investigation playbooks across network, endpoint, identity, and cloud, mapped to NIST CSF 2.0 and MITRE ATT&CK.

outcomes.description: Endpoint containment with SOAR-to-CrowdStrike API automation and approval controls.

featured.title: SafePay ransomware, deconstructed
featured.summary: A two-part breakdown of CISA advisory AA26-293A: what can be done today, and the long-term detection engineering that holds as indicators change.
points: Sort every indicator into block, verify, alert, or hunt before loading it.
Build detections in the order they fire, earliest attack step first.
Validate each rule by trying to break it, and report coverage per kill-chain stage.
